title: Fire theme record
description: A product's look as one record: palette, tone, type and dials. Every field is optional (a missing field is Fire's default); an unknown field is an error. fire/js/theme.js validateTheme() applies the same rules; scripts/test/theme.test.mjs checks that the two agree and that the enums match Fire's palette and type set lists.

fire.description: The Fire release the record was written against; Facet and products pin the expander by it.

palette.description: A palette name, or a spec that fire/js/theme.js paletteFrom() turns into a palette that passes every preset rule.

tone.description: Bends whichever palette is selected, as the Tweaks panel's Tone sliders do.

vivid.description: Scales the accent's chroma, in percent (0 is a grey accent).

light.description: Shifts the accent's OKLCH lightness by this many hundredths.

warmth.description: Tints the neutrals toward blue (negative) or yellow-orange (positive).

type.description: A type set name, or the families of the three voices (the page loads those fonts).

corners.description: --fd-radius-scale: 0 square, 1 default, 2 round. Tweaks steps by 0.125.

contrast.description: data-contrast="high" strengthens muted text, lines and control edges.

texture.description: --fd-texture: the strength of the generative textures. Tweaks steps by 0.05.

signature.description: The signature: Fire's generated texture and frame marks as one set of dials. Written as data-signature-* attributes on <html>, only where not the default; every texture not pinned with data-signature="own" takes the page's value over its own option.

field.description: data-signature-field: the field of every unpinned texture. "auto" leaves each instance its own.

mark.description: data-signature-mark: the mark a field is drawn in (data-style): characters, halftone discs, squares, plus signs or dashes. "auto" leaves each field its own.

cell.description: data-signature-cell: the cell width in px (the height follows). "auto" leaves each instance its own.

ramp.description: data-signature-ramp: a named character ramp, for the density levels of every mark. "auto" leaves each field its own.

marks.description: data-signature-marks: the marks where a frame's bands meet its rails (default "crosses"). A frame or band's own data-marks wins.

intensity.description: data-signature-intensity: the luminance multiplier of every texture without its own data-intensity. Tweaks steps by 0.05.

family.description: A font family name, quoted in CSS.

fromAccent.description: A palette built from one accent, on ember's lightness structure.

neutral.description: The neutrals' temperature: pure grey, cool (blue), warm (sand), tinted toward the accent (the default), or a hue in degrees.

on.description: The label on the accent fill. Left out: whichever reads better.

fromBrand.description: A palette built from brand colours: the engine picks the accent and the neutrals' temperature.

paletteSpec.description: The compact spec fire/js/palettes.js expands its presets from.

tint.description: Page chroma [light, dark]; surfaces, lines and washes scale from it.

h.description: The ink's hue, when it differs from the neutrals'.

accent.description: [light, dark?] accents (dark is derived when left out), or "ink" for a monochrome palette.

on.description: The label on the accent: white, a tinted near-black, or the page's inverse ink; one, or a [light, dark] pair.

L.description: Per-step OKLCH lightness overrides [light, dark]; null keeps ember's.

surfaceTint.description: Light-mode surface chroma relative to the page tint.
